SELECT activityType, activityGroup, activityId, targetId, targetTitle, content, createdAt
FROM (
SELECT 'TIP_POST' AS activityType, 'POST' AS activityGroup, t.tip_id AS activityId, t.tip_id AS targetId, t.title AS targetTitle, t.content AS content, t.created_at AS createdAt
FROM tb_tip t
WHERE t.user_id = #{value}
AND t.status = 'ACTIVE'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'MATE_POST' AS activityType, 'POST' AS activityGroup, m.mate_id AS activityId, m.mate_id AS targetId, m.title AS targetTitle, m.content AS content, m.created_at AS createdAt
FROM tb_mate m
WHERE m.user_id = #{value}
AND m.status = 'ACTIVE'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TIP_COMMENT' AS activityType, 'COMMENT' AS activityGroup, c.comment_id AS activityId, t.tip_id AS targetId, t.title AS targetTitle, c.content AS content, c.created_at AS createdAt
FROM tb_tip_comment c
INNER JOIN tb_tip t ON t.tip_id = c.tip_id
WHERE c.user_id = #{value}
AND c.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND t.status = 'ACTIVE'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'MATE_COMMENT' AS activityType, 'COMMENT' AS activityGroup, c.comment_id AS activityId, m.mate_id AS targetId, m.title AS targetTitle, c.content AS content, c.created_at AS createdAt
FROM tb_mate_comment c
INNER JOIN tb_mate m ON m.mate_id = c.mate_id
WHERE c.user_id = #{value}
AND c.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND m.status = 'ACTIVE'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ITINERARY_COMMENT' AS activityType, 'COMMENT' AS activityGroup, c.comment_id AS activityId, i.itinerary_id AS targetId, i.title AS targetTitle, c.content AS content, c.created_at AS createdAt
FROM tb_itinerary_comment c
INNER JOIN tb_itinerary i ON i.itinerary_id = c.itinerary_id
WHERE c.user_id = #{value}
AND c.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND i.status = 'ACTIVE'
) activity
ORDER BY createdAt DESC
